heading: Pigalle by Villamoura the home of Exceptional Seafood and Grills
taglineHeading: Nestled in the heart of Sandton at Nelson Mandela Square, Pigalle by Villamoura offers more than just a meal — it’s an experience.

faqs.question: Do I need a reservation?
faqs.answer: Reservations are recommended, especially for evenings and weekends. Walk-ins are welcome and will be seated subject to availability.

faqs.question: What cuisine do you serve?
faqs.answer: Our menu brings together Portuguese and Mediterranean-inspired dishes with a classic South African twist, including fresh seafood and flame-grilled favourites.

faqs.question: Do you cater for dietary requirements?
faqs.answer: We are happy to accommodate most dietary requirements. Please let our team know when making your reservation so we can prepare the best experience for you.

faqs.question: Can I host a private event at Pigalle?
faqs.answer: Yes. We host birthdays, corporate events, pre-wedding occasions and more. Contact us to discuss your plans and available options.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: You can find us in the heart of Sandton at Nelson Mandela Square. Visit our booking page for directions and reservation details.
